description: Personal data. Secrets and PII are ONE must-not-leak class here and the action on any match is redaction, because the downstream use is semantic analysis at scale: a false positive is cheap and a false negative is catastrophic. That inverts the usual tuning direction — recall over precision — and it is only affordable because redact-always removes the machinery a blocking policy needs (no quarantine, no held-back files, no operator retry loop).
